method: Requests serialized, configurations run sequentially, 3 timed requests after model load, tokenizer checks and one cancelled prefill. Startup excluded. CPU uses 4 threads. No concurrent benchmark or test workloads.

cpu.text: Translation quality depends on context, terminology, and the structure of the original document. A useful system should preserve numbers, dates, and product names while producing natural sentences. This benchmark compares the same full precision model on the CPU and the GPU. It measures the delay before the first output token and the time spent generating subsequent tokens, while checking the translated text and the numerical differences between the two implementations.
cpu.translation: 翻訳品質は、文脈、用語、および原文の構造に依存する。

limits: The 8B auto configurations have different startup budgets and retained weight amounts; the speedup includes memory residency and avoided I/O, not only GPU arithmetic.
The 81-input-token performance probe stops at 12 generated tokens and is not a full translation.
Numerical and translation checks cover selected probes, not broad translation-quality equivalence.
Short small-model requests can be faster on CPU; auto prefers Metal without per-request autotuning.
31B was built and tested with synthetic loading only; real 31B GPU inference was not measured.
